approvedBy: Codex editorial review, authorized by the owner on 2026-09-22
firstPlayerRule: No one takes an individual first turn: players count to three together, then simultaneously point at a mushroom.
clarifications: Before play, choose someone to distribute the life stones. The rules suggest a banker, or otherwise the player with the nicest jewelry.
The distributor is a setup role, not a first-turn player.
